description: Config-driven registry of markets tracked by the recurring monthly full-hydration and weekly smoke jobs. Adding a new tracked market requires adding an entry here (plus a reviewed seed + a hydration mode in screener.py); it must NOT require editing the driver loop code.

markets.notes: Yahoo Finance public endpoints (unofficial); no API credential. Full seed = 1838 active entries.

markets.denominator_label: NASDAQ listed equities (security-type-filtered, reviewed static seed)
markets.notes: EODHD fundamentals (.US symbols). Full active = 3434 security-type-filtered listed equities. Requires EODHD_API_KEY at runtime (fail-closed without it).

markets.denominator_label: NYSE listed equities (NASDAQ Trader otherlisted Exchange=N, security-type-filtered)
markets.notes: EODHD fundamentals (.US symbols). Full active count resolves from the reviewed security-type-filtered NYSE seed at runtime. Requires EODHD_API_KEY at runtime (fail-closed without it).

markets.denominator_label: LSE listed issuers from official issuer workbook; provider-symbol mapping required
markets.disabled_reason: LSE issuer workbook is the official denominator. Current reviewed mapping artifact lse-provider-symbol-mapping.accounting.json accounts all 1522 issuers as unmapped because no approved provider symbol reference/API access was available; enable only after a regenerated provider-symbol mapping accounts every issuer as mapped, unmapped, failed, ambiguous, or excluded and the resulting partial/full coverage wording is reviewed.

markets.denominator_label: TSE/JPX listed equities from JPX listed-issues workbook; Prime/Standard/Growth domestic+foreign only
markets.disabled_reason: Authenticated EODHD discovery found no Japan/Tokyo exchange code (70 exchanges-list entries, 0 JP candidates; Toyota suffix probes returned 404). Enable only if a future EODHD exchange code is verified and TSE seed mapping remains fully accounted. Yahoo .T aliases are bounded-smoke only.

not applicable to the recurring full-universe cadence: the only committed US seed (us-sp500-constituents.seed.json, 503 names) is a curated S&P 500 sample (known_sample_universe), NOT a full US/NYSE exchange listing. Selecting it with offset 0 / unbounded would wrongly yield denominator_status=complete_exchange_listing via select_us_universe_batch and mislabel a 503-name sample as a complete US exchange universe. The codebase has no reviewed full-US ordinary-share seed (generate_us_universe_seed.py explicitly does not enumerate the ~7000 NYSE/NASDAQ names), and NASDAQ already provides recurring full-universe coverage of the US listed-equity surface. US is therefore explicitly disabled here rather than silently omitted; re-enable only after a reviewed full-US seed + a recurring-safe mode that preserves an honest denominator_status.
